svg.text: 1972 Plymouth Fury wagon · Dr. Eleanor Vance — contestant vehicle dossier
“Some maps are only completed by arriving.”
Body papered in maps — real (USGS) and impossible
The Quiet Coast, drawn again and again
plastered in layered, taped, peeling paper maps
both real and impossible, a compass and sextant
on the dash, weathered and obsessive, realistic
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~50k tris · PBR 4K
